bugs.title: Running-header heuristic wipes real dialogue: any character whose lines differ only by digits, or who says the same short line 3+ times (e.g. PEDRO: 'Sim.' x3), gets every line auto-marked 'Texto não pertencente' and loses its speaker
bugs.evidence: POST /api/scripts with 'PEDRO: Sim.' x3 + 'RUI: Fala do Rui numero 0..3' -> 200, lines kind=foreign: [(0,'RUI — Fala do Rui numero 0.'),...,(8,'PEDRO — Sim.'),(10,'PEDRO — Sim.'),(12,'PEDRO — Sim.')]. Cause: server.py mark_non_script 'headers' rule (key() replaces digits with #; len(set(ts))==1 && len>=3). Fix idea: require the line to look like a header (e.g. uppercase/contains '—'/'Acto'), not merely repeated, and never digit-fold dialogue. Test: e1_tests/test_tscheck_settings_nonbelong.py::test_similar_dialogue_not_marked_header

action_items.detail: Settings 'invalid key shows invalid status' NOT exercised: saving an invalid key would overwrite the user's live keys (all now source=app). Verify manually or expose a dry-run validate endpoint.

Seed fact stale: ElevenLabs key is now VALID (tts_primary=elevenlabs), so voices-tab-edge (expects edge) fails by design of the old check; not an app bug. Deepgram/Gemini keys also changed (last4 ff29/dUOA, source=app).

Selector drift: testid current-block-line-N was removed with the Teleprompter rewrite; checks updated to use the script panel's active line class. Consider adding data-current='true' on the active script-line for stable testing.
Live transcript 2-line clamp verified only statically (line-clamp-2 class); real-mic accuracy needs human testing.
